basic_details.job_title: Railtel Senior DGM Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Railtel Corporation of India Ltd (RAILTEL) has published a notification for 1 Sr. DGM (E5) post on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can submit their offline application by post or through proper channel to the Corporate Office/RCIL, East Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi on or before 21 November 2026, with applications starting on 22 October 2026. The qualification for the post requires IRSSE/Gazetted S&T Officers of Railways/Railway PSUs, and the notified pay is DPE scales and allowances of the level of selection. The selection process involves application through proper channel and re-employment

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: All Posts: Below 62 years (As on Closing date of receipt of application)

qualification.education_qualification: Gazetted S&T officers of Railways / Railway PSUs
qualification.details: Sr. DGM (E5): IRSSE / Gazetted S&T Officers of Railways / Railway PSUs. Experience: Retired/resigned from JAG (Level 12) or Sr. Scale (Level 11) with 8 years of gazetted service, or retired/resigned from E-5 or above level from any Railways PSU.

salary_details.pay_scale: DPE scales and allowances of the level of selection
salary_details.details: Sr. DGM (E5): DPE scales and allowances of the level of selection

selection_process: Application through proper channel Re-employment selection as per Railtel terms and conditions
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for RAILTEL Sr. DGM (E5) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: WWW.RAILTEL.IN.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-11-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for RAILTEL Sr. DGM (E5) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: WWW.RAILTEL.IN. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-11-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Railtel Corporation of India Ltd (RAILTEL) for filling vacant positions in Western Region.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post notified?
faq.answer: The notified post is Sr. DGM (E5) under the Operations & Maintenance (O&M) department for handling network backbone projects.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Sr. DGM (E5) post in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed offline application form is 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in offline mode by post through proper channel to the Corporate Office in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Applicants must be IRSSE or Gazetted S&T Officers of Railways or Railway PSUs with relevant service experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 62 years of age as on the closing date of receipt of the application.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive DPE scales and allowances corresponding to the level of selection.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the Corporate Office/RCIL located at Plate-A, 6th Floor, Office Block, Tower-2, East Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi - 110023.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF and application form from the official website WWW.RAILTEL.IN.
